question.text: The equation of motion of a projectile is <math><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>12</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></mfrac><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>, where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi></math> are in metre. What is the range (in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>) of the projectile?

solution.text:
y = 12 x - 3 4 x 2



Range is the point where y = 0

thus 0 = 12 x - 3 4 x 2

⇒     x = 0

or    x = 16 m
